pools.name: android-redroid
pools.probe: d=/data/local/tmp/.drums_probe; rm -rf $d; mkdir -p $d; settings list system > $d/1 & settings list secure > $d/2 & settings list global > $d/3 & pm list packages > $d/4 & content query --uri content://com.android.contacts/raw_contacts --projection display_name > $d/5 2>/dev/null & content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection title > $d/6 2>/dev/null & wait; cat $d/1 $d/2 $d/3 | grep -vE '{EXCLUDE}' | sort; find /sdcard/ -type f 2>/dev/null | sort; sort $d/4; sort $d/5; sort $d/6; rm -rf $d; ls /data/local/tmp 2>/dev/null | sort
